eyebrow: Guide · Aries · Love, now to New Year
title: Aries: five weeks
when love comes first
summary: Love has been an afterthought lately. Why that was so for an Aries Moon, what the weeks to New Year are read as if you are single or partnered, and the dates to know.
film: Aries: your next five weeks in love
imageAlt: Maya holding an Aries flag, with the ram and Venus beside her
inside: Why love slipped down your list this autumn
What Venus in your house of partners is read as, single or partnered
The dates inside the five weeks, and what changes after New Year
intro: If you are an Aries by Moon sign, love may have felt like the thing you would get to later. Work came first, or worry did, and anything tender waited at the bottom of the list. You did not stop caring. The tradition has a plain reason for a stretch like that, and it ended on Sunday, November 22.

From that day until Friday, January 1, Venus, the planet of love, is in your house of partners, and she is there in a sign she rules. This guide explains what that is read as, whether you are single or with someone, which days inside the five weeks matter, and what follows once the year turns.

sections.label: Why love slipped
title: An autumn that
went backwards.
paragraphs: Venus arrived in your house of partners, the seventh house counted from your Moon sign, back in early September. Then on October 3 she turned retrograde, which means that from where we stand she appeared to move backwards. The tradition reads a retrograde Venus as a time of second thoughts in love: old names coming up, plans stalling, a feeling of going over the same ground.

On November 5 she slipped back into the sign before, which for you is the house of daily work, the sixth house. It is the house of chores, duties and small worries, and it is also the sign where the tradition says Venus is at her weakest. Love there is read as something you fit in around everything else. If the first half of November was all task lists and no tenderness, that is the picture.
She turned to move forward again on November 13 and came back into your house of partners on November 22. She does not turn around again before she leaves.

sections.label: The five weeks
title: Venus at home
in your house of partners.
paragraphs: The sign she is in now is Libra. By the tradition's rules Venus rules Libra, and a planet in a sign it rules is described as a guest in her own home: comfortable, generous and able to do what she does best. For an Aries Moon, Libra is the house of partners, which covers marriage, committed relationships and the people you meet one to one.
So the weeks to New Year are read as a time when partnership moves to the front of your life. Aries is the only Moon sign for which this is true right now.
One caution that the tradition gives with this placement: it is easy to bend too far to keep the peace. Being warm is the point. Giving up what you want to seem agreeable is not.

items.name: If you are single
items.text: This is read as a good stretch for meeting people, and for being met halfway. Introductions through friends, a party you nearly skipped, a message you finally answer. Nobody can say who you will meet or when. The reading is simply that company is easier to find and you are easier to approach.

items.name: If you are partnered
items.text: This is read as a time for sweetness coming back into the everyday. Kind words land better, small gestures are noticed, and a conversation you have been avoiding tends to go more gently than you fear. It favours time that is only for the two of you.

items.name: If it is complicated
items.text: The backward stretch in October and early November may have stirred up someone from the past. With Venus moving forward again, the tradition reads this as a clearer time to decide what you actually want, and to say it kindly.

rows.note: The planet of talk shares your house of partners until this day. Read as the easiest days for an honest conversation, an apology or asking someone out.
The calm, detached influence that has sat in your house of romance since May 18, 2025 moves on. Read as feeling coming back into dating, play and affection.
The Moon is new in your house of depth. Read as a quiet night for an honest thought about what you want from love, rather than a big gesture.
The Moon is full in your house of courage and messages. Read as a good evening to send the message or make the call.
Venus leaves your house of partners. What you started in these weeks carries on, in a quieter key.

sections.label: Romance and the spark
title: A helper in your
house of romance.
paragraphs: The house of partners is about commitment. The house of romance, the fifth house, is about the fun that comes before it and keeps it alive: flirting, dates, play. For a year and a half a calm, detached influence, the one the tradition calls the tail of the dragon, has been sitting there. It is read as romance feeling flat or far away, even when nothing is wrong.

It leaves on December 5. The planet of luck and growth has been in the same house since October 31 and stays until January 23, well past New Year. With the detached influence gone, the tradition reads that as warmth and good humour returning to your love life. The same day, the restless half of the pair enters your house of career, so work may get louder in December. That is one more reason to protect time for love on purpose.

sections.label: After New Year
title: Quieter,
and deeper.
paragraphs: On January 1 Venus moves into your house of depth, the eighth house, and stays until January 28. This house is about trust, privacy and what two people share behind closed doors. Love there is read as less showy and more honest: fewer parties, longer talks. It is a useful stretch for building on something that began in December, and for saying the true thing you held back while everything was light.

steps.name: Make the first move
steps.text: Aries does not do well waiting to be chosen. If there is someone you like, or something you want from your partner, say so in these weeks instead of hoping they guess.

steps.name: Say yes to invitations
steps.text: This is read as a stretch for meeting people one to one. Go to the dinner, the birthday, the thing a friend keeps asking you to. You can always leave early.

steps.name: Plan one proper date
steps.text: If you are partnered, put one evening in the calendar that is not about chores or screens. Choose the place yourself and treat it as a real occasion.

steps.name: Have the conversation early
steps.text: If something needs to be said, the days up to December 2 are read as the easiest for it. Keep it kind, keep it short, and listen as much as you speak.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know. You can find yours for free on AstrolGuru with your birth date, time and place.

faq.q: Does this mean I will meet someone by New Year?
faq.a: No one can promise that. The tradition reads these weeks as supportive for love and partnership for an Aries Moon. What you do with them, and your own birth chart, decide the rest.

faq.q: What does it mean that Venus rules Libra?
faq.a: In Vedic astrology each sign has a ruling planet, and Venus rules Taurus and Libra. A planet in a sign it rules is read as comfortable and strong there, so the things it stands for, here love and harmony, are said to come more easily.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, read by Moon sign.
